rules.statement: In circumstances where strict adherence to the letter of the law would result in injustice, the Court should exercise its judicial discretion to temper the rigidity of the law, allowing the spirit of justice to prevail by granting a deserving litigant the relief to which he is entitled.
rules.supporting_quote: It is my considered view that, in circumstances where strict adherence to the letter of the law would result in injustice, the Court should exercise its judicial discretion to temper the rigidity of the law, allowing the spirit of justice to prevail by granting a deserving litigant the relief to which he is entitled.
